messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS unavailable Sat 02:00-06:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Please note the document management system will be unavailable this Saturday between 02:00 and 06:00 GMT for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close all documents before Friday evening. No action is required.

IT Helpdesk, Whitfield Carter LLP
